snap.zh: 📸 路從岩洞中間穿過去欸，這張一定要留。
snap.en: 📸 The road goes right through the rock. Gotta keep this one.

snap.zh: 📸 紅頭岩，收下！等黃昏再來看它變紅。
snap.en: 📸 Hongtou Rock, got it! I'll come back at dusk to see it turn red.

snap.zh: 📸 洞口外面就是海，構圖自己就跑出來了。
snap.en: 📸 The sea's right outside the tunnel. The shot basically framed itself.

snap.zh: 📸 鯉魚岩！你們看，真的有點像魚在跳。
snap.en: 📸 Carp Rock! Look, it really does kind of look like a jumping fish.

snap.zh: 📸 好，這條魚被我收進相簿了。
snap.en: 📸 Okay, this fish is in the album now.

snap.zh: 📸 坦克岩，炮管對著海，蠻有氣勢的。
snap.en: 📸 Tank Rock, barrel pointed at the sea. Pretty impressive.

snap.zh: 📸 拍到了。名字是地圖取的，族人怎麼叫它，我們再問問。
snap.en: 📸 Got it. The name's from the maps. Let's ask what the Tao call it.

snap.zh: 📸 從燈塔看下去，整片海都是藍的。
snap.en: 📸 From the lighthouse, the whole sea is blue.

snap.zh: 📸 風好大，手要穩……好，拍到了！
snap.en: 📸 So windy. Steady hands… okay, got it!

snap.zh: 📸 這個高度看島，跟走路的時候完全不一樣。
snap.en: 📸 The island looks totally different from up here.

name.en: Five Holes Cave (photos from outside only)

snap.zh: 📸 五孔洞我們就在外面遠遠拍，不進去打擾。
snap.en: 📸 We'll just shoot the Five Holes Cave from outside. No need to go in and disturb it.

snap.zh: 📸 遠遠的一張就夠了，留給這個地方安靜。
snap.en: 📸 One shot from afar is enough. Let the place stay quiet.

snap.zh: 📸 玉女岩，安安靜靜站在海邊。
snap.en: 📸 Jade Maiden Rock, standing quietly by the sea.

snap.zh: 📸 收進相簿。光線剛好，運氣不錯。
snap.en: 📸 Into the album. The light's just right. Lucky.

snap.zh: 📸 小天池遠遠看就好，那邊是要尊重的地方。
snap.en: 📸 We'll keep Little Heaven Lake at a distance. It's a place to respect.

snap.zh: 📸 遠拍一張，水面像鏡子一樣。
snap.en: 📸 One from afar. The water's like a mirror.

snap.zh: 📸 母雞岩！真的像一隻在孵蛋的雞。
snap.en: 📸 Hen Rock! It really looks like a hen sitting on eggs.

snap.zh: 📸 拍好了，下面那片海聽說很適合浮潛。
snap.en: 📸 Done. I hear the water down there is great for snorkelling.

snap.zh: 📸 雙獅岩上面全是星星……快門要開久一點。
snap.en: 📸 Stars all over Twin Lions Rock… gotta keep the shutter open longer.

snap.zh: 📸 這片星空，城市裡根本看不到。
snap.en: 📸 You just can't see stars like this in the city.

snap.zh: 📸 大家先別動喔……好，拍到了！
snap.en: 📸 Everybody hold still… okay, got it!

snap.zh: 📸 軍艦岩從岸上拍就好，船開過去太遠了。
snap.en: 📸 We'll shoot Battleship Rock from the shore. It's too far out by boat.

snap.zh: 📸 遠遠看真的像一艘船停在海上。
snap.en: 📸 From here it really looks like a ship parked at sea.

snap.zh: 📸 情人洞，海浪一直往洞裡打。
snap.en: 📸 Lovers' Cave, with the waves rolling right in.

snap.zh: 📸 拍到了。腳下石頭滑，大家小心。
snap.en: 📸 Got it. The rocks are slippery, careful everyone.

snap.zh: 📸 一線天！抬頭只看得到一條天空。
snap.en: 📸 Sky Crack! Look up and there's just a sliver of sky.

snap.zh: 📸 兩邊的山壁好近，拍起來好有壓迫感。
snap.en: 📸 The cliffs are so close. Feels intense in the shot.

snap.zh: 📸 東清灣的日出，早起值得了！
snap.en: 📸 Sunrise at Dongqing Bay. Totally worth getting up early!

snap.zh: 📸 太陽從海裡冒出來的那一秒，拍到了。
snap.en: 📸 Caught the second the sun came up out of the sea.

snap.zh: 📸 等一下，再一張……好，這張最好看。
snap.en: 📸 Wait, one more… okay, this one's the best.

snap.zh: 📸 鋼盔岩，好像有人把頭盔放在海邊。
snap.en: 📸 Helmet Rock. Like someone left a helmet by the sea.

snap.zh: 📸 收下！這顆石頭圓得好可愛。
snap.en: 📸 Got it! Such a cute round rock.

snap.zh: 📸 象鼻岩，鼻子直接伸進海裡。
snap.en: 📸 Elephant Trunk Rock, its trunk dipping right into the sea.

snap.zh: 📸 角度對了，真的是一隻大象。
snap.en: 📸 From the right angle, it really is an elephant.

snap.zh: 📸 蘭嶼瀑布，水聲好大，好涼。
snap.en: 📸 Lanyu Waterfall. So loud, so cool.

snap.zh: 📸 拍到了。相機有點濕，值得。
snap.en: 📸 Got it. The camera's a bit wet. Worth it.

snap.zh: 📸 龍頭岩，看起來隨時要游出去。
snap.en: 📸 Dragon Head Rock. Looks like it could swim off any second.

snap.zh: 📸 好，龍頭收進相簿了。
snap.en: 📸 Okay, the dragon's head is in the album.

snap.zh: 📸 大天池遠遠拍一張就好，不靠近。
snap.en: 📸 Just one of Big Heaven Lake from afar. We won't go closer.

snap.zh: 📸 被山圍著的一片水，好安靜。
snap.en: 📸 A pool of water ringed by mountains. So peaceful.

snap.zh: 📸 老人岩，像一個人坐著看海。
snap.en: 📸 Old Man Rock, like someone sitting and watching the sea.

snap.zh: 📸 拍到了。他應該在這裡看很久了吧。
snap.en: 📸 Got it. He's probably been watching for a long time.

snap.zh: 📸 青青草原的黃昏，整片草都變金色。
snap.en: 📸 Dusk on Qingqing Prairie. The whole field's gone gold.

snap.zh: 📸 風吹過來好舒服……好，拍到了。
snap.en: 📸 The breeze feels so nice… okay, got it.

snap.zh: 📸 這張我要拿來當桌布。
snap.en: 📸 This one's going to be my wallpaper.

name.zh: 八代灣（飛魚季只能在部落外遠拍）
name.en: Badai Bay (in flying fish season, only from outside the village)

snap.zh: 📸 八代灣我們在部落外遠遠拍，不打擾族人。
snap.en: 📸 We'll shoot Badai Bay from outside the village. Don't want to bother anyone.

snap.zh: 📸 遠遠的一張，海灣好漂亮。
snap.en: 📸 One from afar. The bay's beautiful.

snap.zh: 📸 饅頭岩，圓圓的，看了肚子都餓了。
snap.en: 📸 Mantou Rock, round like a steamed bun. Now I'm hungry.

snap.zh: 📸 拍好了！等一下去吃點東西吧。
snap.en: 📸 Done! Let's go grab something to eat.

snap.zh: 📸 開元港，我們上島的地方。
snap.en: 📸 Kaiyuan Harbour, where we landed.

snap.zh: 📸 船進進出出好熱鬧，拍一張留念。
snap.en: 📸 Boats coming and going, so lively. One for the memories.

snap.zh: 📸 航空站就拍風景，小小的跑道好可愛。
snap.en: 📸 Just the scenery at the airport. Such a tiny runway.

snap.zh: 📸 好，拍到了。下次搭飛機來就是這裡落地。
snap.en: 📸 Okay, got it. Next time we fly in, this is where we land.

name.zh: 從蘭嶼氣象觀測站俯瞰
name.en: View down from the Lanyu Weather Station

snap.zh: 📸 從氣象站看下去，半座島都在腳下。
snap.en: 📸 From the weather station, half the island is at your feet.

snap.zh: 📸 爬上來好累，但這張值得！
snap.en: 📸 Tiring climb, but this shot's worth it!

name.zh: 野銀傳統家屋（先問屋主）
name.en: Ivalino traditional houses (ask the owner first)

snap.zh: 📸 屋主說可以，我們就拍遠一點的整片家屋。
snap.en: 📸 The owner said it's okay, so we'll get the houses from a bit further back.

snap.zh: 📸 謝謝屋主。房子低低的貼著地，好聰明的設計。
snap.en: 📸 Thanks to the owner. The houses sit low against the ground. Such clever design.

name.zh: 朗島灣的拼板舟（先問船主）
name.en: Plank boats at Iraraley Bay (ask the owner first)

snap.zh: 📸 船主答應了，我們遠遠拍就好，不碰船。
snap.en: 📸 The boat owner said yes. We'll shoot from afar and not touch the boats.

snap.zh: 📸 謝謝船主。拼板舟停在灣裡，好美。
snap.en: 📸 Thanks to the owner. The plank boats in the bay look beautiful.

name.zh: 椰油港斷崖：跟潛水教練做淺水氣瓶潛水
name.en: Yayo Harbour drop-off: a shallow scuba dive with the dive coach
